1. Pad each row with the border mode and add up its first n values.
2. Slide along the row. Add the value that enters the window and subtract the value that leaves it.
3. Divide each sum by n to get the row means.
4. Do the same along each column of the row means.
5. Round to 8 bits. Keep alpha unchanged.
